response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT fundflux, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT fundflux, cnt AS spatial_record_count, share, cnt - avg_cnt AS excess_over_average FROM t WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Projects with a NULL fundflux form their own group. That group counts as one funding source in the total, the average, and the output.
The average count is the unweighted mean of the per-source counts, that is, total matched records divided by the number of funding sources. It is not an average per record or per project.
The share and excess are computed with decimal division (no integer truncation) and are not rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat a NULL funding source as not a real source: drop those projects before counting, so they affect neither the total nor the average.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT fundflux, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT fundflux, cnt AS spatial_record_count, share, cnt - avg_cnt AS excess_over_average FROM t WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
